source_text: From child rights perspectives, critics invoke the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC), ratified by 196 states as of 2023, arguing that non-therapeutic circumcision violates Article 19 (protection from violence), Article 24 (right to health), and Article 37 (prohibition of torture or cruel treatment) by inflicting permanent alteration without the child's informed consent or demonstrable medical necessity. [81]
